page.layout: One page of text; a column of marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first lines of the body. Running head and heading at the top, centred.

main_text.head: IVSTI LIPSII DE CRVCE LIBER III.
CAPVT I.
Transitiò ad Rarum figendi Modum. Furca divisa, & hîc de Ignominiosâ dictum.
main_text.p: ABunde, quæ ad Vulgarem crucifigendi modum, diximus : Rarus supereft, quem ipsum pari curâ imus expunctum. Eum suprà descripsimus (& vox præfert) sepositum, Quid rarus modus? Is divisus.& minùs in assiduo usu. Sepositum ævo, Inusitatum vel Schemate vel Fine. De his tribus ordine & partitè dicam (juvat in his talibus) & in lucem fortasse protraham, quæ usque adhuc parum claro oculo confpecta. Ævo seposita Furca est: olim quidem in creberrimo usu, sed quæ paulatim
main_text.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter. The left-margin note is set in small type and only partly legible; "Quid rarus modus? Is divisus." is a best reading. Several words are uncertain, notably "seposita" and "confpecta", and are left as printed.
